channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Herat municipality launches campaign to plant 28,000 saplings
item.description: The Municipality of western Herat has launched a large-scale tree-planting campaign in the provincial capital, aiming to plant around 28,000 non-fruit saplings across the city to expand urban green spaces.

item.title: Justice ministry launches online system to boost transaction transparency
item.description: The Ministry of Justice (MoJ) has announced the launch of an online system for real estate dealers and petition writers, aimed at enhancing transparency and facilitating the issuance of licenses as well as the registration of real estate and motor vehicle transactions.

item.title: Japan provides over $6m to support polio eradication in Afghanistan
item.description: Japan has donated $6.26 million to the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) to support efforts to eradicate the polio virus in Afghanistan.

item.title: National policy for agriculture, livestock, fish farming approved
item.description: The Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs announced that the national policy for the development of the agriculture and livestock sector, along with the fish farming development plan, has been approved. Under this plan, 7,700 small, medium, and large fish production and farming farms will be established.

item.title: 1 killed, 19 injured in Nimroz collision
item.description: ZARANJ (Pajhwok): One person was killed and 19 others were injured in a collision between two passenger vehicles on the Zaranj–Delaram highway in southwestern Nimroz

item.title: Afghanistan, South Africa to meet in ICC T20 WC encounter today
item.description: Afghanistan are all set to meet South Africa in their second group-stage match in the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup today (Wednesday) at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad.

item.title: 1 killed, 7 injured in Ghazni traffic accident
item.description: One person has been killed and seven others have been injured in a traffic accident in southern Ghazni province, police said on Wednesday.

item.title: Canada school shooting leaves 10 dead
item.description: At least 10 people, including the suspected gunwoman, have been killed and several others wounded in a school shooting in Canada’s British Columbia province, media reported on Wednesday.

item.title: 1 killed, another wounded in Nangarhar mine collapse
item.description: A man has been killed and another injured in a mine collapse in the eastern Nangarhar province, police said on Wednesday.
